Name: Voids OURple Watermill
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
Something OURple fresh and new, don't burn your fingers it's that hot!

Saw the watermill and was like "Hey, this would look good in OURple" and BAM I did it because why not? What else is there to say besides: enjoy a little bit more OURple in the valley!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
Since it uses the new skin feature it should be compatible with any other mod that adds more textures to the watermill!
